forms.title: Workday candidate experience (atlasmutual.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com): account, email verification, Autofill with Resume, 6-step wizard
quirks: single-page app: one shell for every /en-US/AtlasCareers/... URL; job data from /wday/cxs JSON; views switch without page loads
job page Apply (adventureButton) opens a Start Your Application dialog: Autofill with Resume / Apply Manually / Use My Last Application

account wall: Create Account (Email Address, Password, Verify New Password, createAccountCheckbox) with Workday password rules (8+ chars, upper, lower, digit, special, not the email) and server error text

email verification: a 6-digit code mailed from "Atlas Mutual" <atlasmutual@myworkday.com> (subject Verify your candidate account), entered on Verify Your Account; wrong / expired / too many attempts errors; Resend Code
Sign In for an existing account; creating an account with a verified email fails with 'An account with this email address already exists'; unverified sign-in re-sends the code
auth submit buttons are covered by a div[data-automation-id=click_filter] overlay (role=button, same aria-label), so clicking the real button is intercepted
CALYPSO_CSRF_TOKEN cookie must be echoed in X-CALYPSO-CSRF-TOKEN on every account/upload/draft call; fx_session cookie set on verify/sign-in

Autofill with Resume: upload then server-side parse that pre-fills My Information and My Experience with planted parse errors (merged title+company, location as company, wrong start year, 'currently work here' lost, bogus work entry from a project, truncated school, unrecognised degree, GPA with scale, phone with trunk 0 and no country code)
progress bar (progressBarActiveStep / CompletedStep / InactiveStep) with 'current step N of 6' text and a Step N of 6 counter

Save and Continue validates client side: errorBanner 'Errors Found' with count, per-field errorMessage 'The field X is required and must have a value.', aria-invalid; plus format rules (postal code per country, phone per country code, URLs, LinkedIn, dates)
each Save and Continue POSTs that page to /__submit/workday/<step> and PUTs a server draft; Back keeps values; a reload resumes the draft
button dropdowns (button[aria-haspopup=listbox] -> ul[role=listbox] li[role=option]) with keyboard navigation and type-ahead, no native selects

prompts: search box that only searches on Enter, auto-selects a lone match, multi-level How Did You Hear About Us? (Job Board > LinkedIn...), selections as pills with DELETE_charm; multi-select Skills prompt
Country defaults to United States of America; changing it clears and re-labels State/Province
previous-worker Yes/No radios (Yes reveals Employee ID); preferred-name checkbox reveals fields

segmented date spinbuttons (dateSectionMonth-input / dateSectionYear-input / dateSectionDay-input) with auto-advance, arrow keys and a dateIcon calendar; MM/YYYY for work, YYYY for education, MM/DD/YYYY for self-identify
panel sets with Add / Add Another and panel-set-delete-button for Work Experience, Education, Websites; deleting renumbers; I currently work here hides To
file upload: file-upload-drop-zone, select-files over hidden file-upload-input-ref, uploaded file row with delete-file; type/size checks; the autofill upload carries over to My Experience
Application Questions keyed by opaque questionnaire ids (primaryQuestionnaire--<hex>); only the label text says what is asked
Voluntary Disclosures with decline options and a required terms and conditions checkbox; Self Identify (CC-305) with name, MM/DD/YYYY date and three mutually exclusive disability checkboxes
Review page is a read-only summary; Submit posts every page's values plus the resume file (multipart) to /__submit/workday, then candidate home shows Application Submitted and My Applications
Use My Last Application pre-fills from the account's previous submission (consent and signature date cleared)
forms.reference: Public *.myworkdayjobs.com job postings and Workday candidate-experience DOM conventions (data-automation-id names), studied read-only
